```tla
---------------------------- MODULE LivenessStateConstraintWarning ----------------------------
EXTENDS Sequences

VARIABLES pc, history

vars == <<pc, history>>

Init == 
    /\ pc = "A"
    /\ history = <<>>

A == 
    /\ pc = "A"
    /\ pc' = "B"
    /\ history' = Append(history, pc)

B == 
    /\ pc = "B"
    /\ pc' = "A"
    /\ history' = history

Next == A \/ B

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Next)

Constraint == Len(history) < 3

Prop == <>(pc = "Done")

=============================================================================
```
